Same two paths, same invalidFields contract. Re-gated on the rebased tree: 200/200/200 + scalafmtCheckAll, GATE_EXIT=0. Evidence post-01M17HSMM8YBN8M6WK9517NFQ8.

Please treat 80a9ad0 as the candidate, not 717a85a.
